known_limits_summary: The single hard blocker found this session is host memory: loading datapack.unity3d (>1GB) via UnityPy reliably OOMs on this 7.3GB-RAM/4GB-swap host, regardless of thread count, independent of other concurrent jobs.

Everything that stays within libil2cpp.so + global-metadata.dat + small cached JSON/jsonl/gz indexes (ARM64 method contracts, scene-root lookups, class/field name joins) works reliably and was used successfully this session.
Unity Editor batch builds work but contend heavily for the same scarce RAM; running one alongside UnityPy-on-datapack or another Editor instance is not reliable on this host.
